text:
A whole day of eating at Kyoto Station.
Breakfast inside the gates, dinner on 11F 👇

🌅 6:00
Honke Daiichi Asahi opens. Ramen since 1947.
9:00 to 10:00 is calmer. Closed Thursdays.

🚆 6:30
Shiokoji Cafe, inside the JR Central gate.
A Japanese breakfast set under ¥1,000.

🍜 9:00
Shinpuku Saikan, next door, since 1938.
Chuka soba ¥950. Cash only.

🍵 Evening
Isetan 11F: dashi chazuke at Kyoto Obuya.
Or tofu and yuba from Fujino.

⚠️ From 14 Dec 2026, three other
Isetan 11F restaurants close for works.
